result.brief: 提出 iWAM：利用流匹配模型可逆性将未来帧反演为潜噪声，学习双向流映射，使单次视频骨干前向即可为动作策略提供有效未来条件特征，避免显式生成未来帧。
result.reason: Uses pretrained video-generation model features as action-policy conditioning via learned bidirectional flow map, contributing to video world-model representation and efficient latent conditioning.
